title: Protection warrior: never Thunder Claps the sheeped moon mark

rules.desc: No damage from the Protection warrior (direct or Thunder Clap splash) lands on the moon-marked mob while it carries Polymorph
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/values/PossibleAttackTargetsValue.cpp:53-108 (a mob in breakable CC leaves the target list unless nothing else is left); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:830-860 (AoeTrigger: never AoE a pack holding a breakable CC); ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/GenericSpellActions.cpp:46-61 (BreaksCcInArea); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the sheeped mob is only a target when nothing else is left, and Thunder Clap checks for a breakable CC in its radius; three mobs (the moon mark and two others, refilled when one dies) so an unmarked mob is almost always up. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: the Protection warrior casts Thunder Clap at least once in the fight, so the respect rule has splash to respect with
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:161-166 (melee light aoe -> thunder clap at ACTION_HIGH + 7, #949); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: two unmarked mobs in melee hold the light-aoe row active, so the clap fires and the respect rule is not vacuous. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
